description: This file defines the 'Stack' class used within the PhpSpreadsheet library to manage the calculation token stack during formula processing. It includes methods for pushing, popping, inspecting, and clearing stack items, as well as managing branch pruning context during calculations.

classes.name: Stack
classes.description: Implements a stack data structure for managing calculation tokens during spreadsheet formula processing, with branch pruning support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Stack instance with a branch pruner object.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of items currently on the stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes a new item onto the stack, creating a stack entry with optional localization handling for functions.

methods.name: pushStackItem
methods.description: Pushes a pre-constructed stack item onto the stack.

methods.name: getStackItem
methods.description: Creates a new stack item array with type, value, and reference, incorporating branch pruning context.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the top item from the stack, or null if empty.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the nth last item from the stack without removing it.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the stack.
